name: glassbeetle
description: NestJS backend + Angular frontend running inside a Tauri desktop shell.

scripts.dev:gui: wait-on -t 180000 http-get://localhost:3000/api/v1/health http-get://localhost:4200 && npm run tauri:dev -w @glassbeetle/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @glassbeetle/api && npm run build -w @glassbeetle/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w @glassbeetle/api && npm run tauri:build -w @glassbeetle/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @glassbeetle/api && npm run test -w @glassbeetle/web && node --test scripts/stop.spec.mjs
